name: codeonym-oss
description: Open-source Claude Code plugins from codeonym-oss.

plugins.name: groundwork
plugins.description: Plan work before building it: grill an idea into epics, stories and tickets, keep every decision, and build each ticket with your approval at every step.

plugins.name: design-skills
plugins.description: Design skills with a reproducible headless toolchain (Blender, GIMP, Inkscape, Krita, Scribus, darktable, ffmpeg, ImageMagick) in versioned containers.

plugins.name: flow-reel
plugins.description: Make narrated, polished reels of your web app's features: plan the story, explore the app, write a flow-reel script with comments, sounds and effects, compose it and screen the result.

plugins.name: project-reporting
plugins.description: Short reports of a project's finished work: read git, the tracker, plans and demos for any period, keep one file per work item, and write a report its readers understand, in your own format and languages.
